source_evidence: You may actually only be able to sell a certain percentage of the shares you request to have repurchased.
question: Misconception: If an interval fund makes a repurchase offer, I can sell all the shares I request to have repurchased.
answer: A repurchase offer does not guarantee that all your requested shares will be bought back. Interval funds limit how many outstanding shares they repurchase during an offer, and if requests exceed that limit, repurchases are generally made on a pro rata basis.
